claims.statement: Tom Allen issued a challenge in London to fight any man in the world at catch weights.
claims.excerpt: Allen issues a challenge to fight any man in the world at catch weizhts

claims.statement: Tom Allen's challenge was for $1,000 a side under London Prize Ring rules, to be fought in Canada or within fifty miles of Pittsburg, within 100 miles of Buffalo.
claims.excerpt: for $1,000 a side; the fight to take place within 100 miles of Buffalo, and to be fought in Canada or within fifty miles of Pittsburg.

claims.statement: Tom Allen has fought seven times for the heavyweight championship of America.
claims.excerpt: who has fought seven times for the heavy-weizht championship of America

claims.statement: Tom Allen wants to fight Johnny Dwyer, who holds the heavyweight championship of America.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen wants to fight Dwyer; and Paddy Ryan

notes: No individual bouts are described; the fight count is the career claim. The Dwyer and Paddy Ryan items concern other men except Allen's wish to fight Dwyer. Hint 'other' for the seven-times count is recorded as career. The challenge is reported via London advices.
